components.name: Price
components.description: Price or amount — products, plans, fees, balances. Size = S | M | L | XL × Layout = Inline | Stacked × Variant = Default | Sale = 16 variants. Sale shows the current price in danger colour, the struck-through old price (Old price text prop) and a Badge (Filled · Danger, exposed). Note line is optional (off by default): billing period, instalment, tax note. Format: "4 234 000 soʻm" — spac
